messages.subject: Using latent factor scores from lavPredict as input data to learn a Bayesian Network
parts:
Hello everyone, 

I intend to compare the prediction performances of 2 methods. One is SEM-based method and other is Bayesian Network based. The SEM-based prediction method predicts the dependent latent factor scores by using basic regression models. I plan to determine latent factor scores in SEM and use them as input data to learn the Bayesian network parameters. 

I am very new in SEM, lavaan and Bayesian statistics, so I have a number of questions. Sorry if they are illogical or pieces of cakes:

1) Just a very simple question: Please assume three latent variables in a fitted model, each have a number of observed variables:
"x =~ a + b + c
y =~ d + e
z =~ f
z ~ 0.6*x + 0.3*y

I need to calculate factor scores of the latents z,x and y. I use lavPredict; lavPredict(fit.model, type="lv", method="regression")
The factor scores lavPredict calculates do not comply with the regression formulae in z ~ 0.6*x + 0.3*y. So, I cannot figure out the computation method of the latent factor scores.

I have looked up on regression and Bartlett factor score estimation methods. However, as a newbie it is so much information for me and now I am much more confused, but I really want to learn the logic behind.Can any of you tell me how lavPredict computes the latent scores as explaining it to a dummy?
